comparison.objective: Insert a ferruled wire into the correct push-in terminal; candidate extracts a crimp terminal from a connector housing.
comparison.physical_skill: Straight ferrule alignment and insertion into a spring clamp versus placing two blades around a recessed contact, depressing two tangs, and push-then-pull extraction.
comparison.success_condition: Ferrule seated and retained after release/tug versus selected terminal and attached wire removed while housing and neighbors remain retained.
comparison.reason: Although both concern terminal cavities, insertion into a spring clamp does not test tool-mediated dual-tang release and withdrawal. Candidate force and damage thresholds remain unmeasured, but that omission does not create plausible duplication.
